request.prompt: Use the licensed original photo as the sole identity and source-camera reference. Make a clean photorealistic catalog cutout of the SAME car, preserving paint color, exact body proportions, door/window layout, lamps, grille, wheels, mirrors, handles and visible trim/accessories. Keep the source camera, viewing direction and body style; do not mirror or invent an unseen opposite end. Clean dirt, scratches and surrounding-scene reflections. Remove environment, people, other vehicles, road, snow and advertising/plate characters. Keep realistic glass/interior and opaque bodywork. Show the COMPLETE car, all visible tires/mirrors and original roof accessories/antenna tips in a roomy frame with useful transparent space on all sides. True RGBA transparency, no floor/contact shadow, under-car reflection, glow, background fragments, captions, watermark or checkerboard. Do not add a shark fin or antenna type absent from the source. Do not infer engine specification or precise model year.  Keep the vehicle comfortably inside the frame with clearly visible transparent margins above every roof accessory, below every tire and beyond both ends; do not enlarge it up to the edges.  Keep FULL vehicle/all tires/mirrors/roof aerial tips inside roomy transparent margins. Do not copy any background-neighbor hardware. This exact SILVER car is FACELIFT KIA RIO II/JB FOUR-DOOR SEDAN, source2010 EX example. Preserve separate trunk/FOUR side doors, source revised tiger-nose mesh upper grille/oval KIA badge, actual updated lower grille and dark FOG-LAMP BLANKING COVERS (do not add foglamps), source actual wheel pattern/body-color mirrors/handles and smooth painted bumpers WITHOUT early broad black rub strips. Keep FRONT-SIDE nearly-side camera nose RIGHT. Source nose is close to original edge: place whole nose and both bumper corners with useful transparent room, not clipped. Do not substitute Russian QB/global UB newer body or preFL upper grille; remove tree/park/dirt/plate letters.
